description: This is a C++ source file implementing Lua scripting integration for a game, including functions for loading, executing, and overriding Lua code, as well as a command interface for executing Lua scripts or code within the game environment.

classes.name: Lua::LuaCommand
classes.description: A command class for executing Lua code or scripts within the game environment.

methods.name: LoadCode
methods.description: Loads Lua code from a buffer into the Lua state.

methods.name: LoadScript
methods.description: Loads a Lua script from a file path.

methods.name: LuaPrint
methods.description: Custom implementation of the Lua print function that outputs to game logs.

methods.name: OverrideGlobalLuaFunctions
methods.description: Overrides global Lua functions such as print and modifies package searchers.

methods.name: ExecCode
methods.description: Loads and executes a string of Lua code.

methods.name: ExecScript
methods.description: Loads and executes a Lua script file.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Lua environment and sets up global functions.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the Lua environment and releases resources.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current Lua state pointer.
